newsitem.title: USA: Tipperary sells 75 pct of Dakota stake.
newsitem.headline: Tipperary sells 75 pct of Dakota stake.

text.p: Tipperary Corp said Tuesday it has sold 75 percent of its working interest in about 30,000 leasehold acres in Divide County, N.D., located in the Williston Basin, for $1,225,000.

Under terms of two separate exploration agreements, Tipperary and two unaffiliated companies, Lyco Energy Corp Dallas and Cavell Energy (U.S.) Corp, will conduct exploration and development activities on the acerage, Tipperary said.
The company said it received $975,000 in cash at closing, and will have $250,000 applied to its share of capital expenditures. The company used $675,000 of the cash proceeds to reduce bank debt.
